goal: A seamless-feeling documentary montage with 4 restored photo scenes and 1 five-second authentic moving color Vidu insert, while preserving the identity of real archival people and objects.

scenes.vidu_position: choose 1,3,or 5 based on source material, motion action and narrative; never rigidly 3

classical.source: verified real public-domain or CC0 archival MOVING film
classical.photo: source-locked modern-quality full-color photoreal still, real AI reconstruction

vidu.start_frame: exact last black-and-white archival source frame, same crop and camera
vidu.first_second: B/W becomes natural color by 1.15 seconds
vidu.next_four_seconds: visible coherent continuous FULL COLOR movement, not freeze or pan/zoom only
vidu.keyframe_strategy: prefer source photo at 1-second color target plus motion-preserving prompt, do not force final freeze in last seconds
vidu.motion_metric: per 0.4s median grayscale difference requires >=0.9 on >= half samples; independent optical-flow and human QA recommended
vidu.fail_action: reject clip or use classical fallback, NEVER automatically resubmit paid API

budget.approval: single-scene exact image/prompt/duration/model/cost before each paid POST

continuity.audio: one uninterrupted original/licensed music bed, revelation cues as accents
continuity.color_grading: white balance, gamma, controlled saturation match across shots, do not blur detailed faces
continuity.crop: same aspect 9:16 (720x1280), no unexpected face cutoffs
continuity.cuts: match cut on movement/composition/beat between DIFFERENT archival shots; no pretending a single camera take
continuity.within_vidu: last original monochrome source frame == first generated Vidu frame, visually check perspective match
continuity.after_vidu: avoid ending on artificial frozen frame, preserve motion until next archival shot

source_rights.historical: PD/CC0 explicitly verified for Italy and origin jurisdiction
source_rights.color_and_faces: AI reconstruction, hypothesis not original color or original identities
source_rights.Vidu: synthetic movement separate from historical original

technical: verify downloads from external GitHub release
artistic: view full video at normal playback
Vidu not replacing authentic historic footage
qa.preview_vs_final: Fail closed: technical preview can show legacy mismatches flagged; production must pass strict gates and manual review

delivery.kit: ZIP with MP4, cover, 4 social descriptions, source and QA
delivery.direct_android: GitHub Release direct MP4 and ZIP; no sandbox-only links
delivery.archive: import to Video Library Studio only after its own publishing gate and verify playback

pilot.label: PARIS 1900–1918, V83 TECHNICAL_PREVIEW
pilot.warning: Different periods, and old Vidu transition took too long to color: demo of montage only; NOT a quality-approved example

production.do_not_modify: V82 base renderer, V55 archival publishing, 4x1 ArtVision rules
production.next_step: Create a same-period matching animated-color Vidu 5-second insert only after individual preflight and approval; then use strict gate
